source_snapshot: Exact worktree bytes at the cited local commit, with pre-existing Git/worktree CRLF differences recorded separately. No bytes are normalized by the exporter.
selection: scalar/gauge lineage plus recursively discovered local imports, frozen inputs and manifest-bound bytes for the selected quantum claims; exact worktree bytes are retained and existing Git/worktree line-ending differences are recorded
scope_limit: Source and evidence snapshot, not Git history or a new scientific acceptance. Historical manifests remain original records; their Git-custody checks may require unavailable historical objects.
partitioning: Two ordinary independent ZIPs; extract both into the same directory. Complete inventory retained, with no overlapping member paths.
